name: ZCA_AI_OBJECT_HINTS
description: Stores AI hint instances specific to an object along with user responses to the hints.

columns.name: OBJECT_HINT_ID
columns.description: Primary key which is system generated.

columns.name: EXPLANATIONS
columns.description: The explanations in Json format

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.description: ID of the task that was created for the recommendation

columns.name: OBJECT_INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: ID of the object specified by OBJECT_TYPE column.

columns.name: OBJECT_UUID
columns.description: Unique ID which is an alternate key.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Object for which hint is applicable; for example, OPPORTUNITY, LEAD, etc.

columns.name: HINT_CODE
columns.description: Code used to identify recommendation.

columns.name: TOP_HINT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the current highest ranked recommendation to display in the UI.

columns.name: PRED_WIN_PROB
columns.description: Win Probability predicted by the AI engine.

columns.name: USER_RESPONSE
columns.description: User's response to a recommendation.

columns.name: RESP_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Resource ID of the user who provided feedback on the recommendation.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of when the hint is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of when the hint is active.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
